objective: Add sprint View modal and Delete API to remove sprint file and database records from UI.

tickets.title: UI — View sprint plan in modal
tickets.objective: Allow owner to view full sprint plan details in a modal without leaving dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard sprint list adds View button per sprint; on click calls GET /projects/:projectId/sprint-plans/:sprintId and opens modal showing id, objective, roadmap_id, project_id, tickets count, tickets table (id, title, priority), and exit_criteria
Modal handles loading, error (404), and close via Esc, backdrop click, and Close button; focus trapped inside modal
View does not mutate state; multiple opens show consistent data from database
Success: View SPRINT-NF-BRIDGE-001 shows 4 tickets correctly
Tests PASS: node --test tests/unit/http-api.test.js related view, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas, npm run build:web, git diff --check

tickets.title: API + UI — Delete sprint plan file and database records
tickets.objective: Allow owner to delete a sprint plan, removing both the uploaded JSON file and persisted database records, with confirmation.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP API adds DELETE /projects/:projectId/sprint-plans/:sprintId; validates projectId and sprintId, returns 404 if not found, 409 if sprint is currently running (orchestration active), 200 { deleted: true, sprint_id } on success

Delete removes: file schemas/examples/governance-sprint-plan-*.json if it matches sprint id, plus rows in .node-control SQLite via roadmapStore/sprintPlanProjection/ticketProvenanceTracker; orphan tickets removed; dashboard no longer lists sprint
Storage check: after DELETE, GET /projects/:projectId/sprint-plans/:sprintId returns 404 and GET /projects/:projectId/dashboard no longer contains sprint

UI dashboard adds Delete button per sprint with confirmation dialog 'Delete SPRINT-xxx? This removes file and database records.'; on confirm calls DELETE, shows success/error toast, refreshes dashboard; delete disabled while sprint is RUNNING
Idempotent: second DELETE for same sprint returns 404

Tests PASS: node --test tests/integration/sprint-plan*.test.js and tests/unit/roadmap-store.test.js for delete, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas, git diff --check; manual smoke: upload then delete SPRINT-NF-BRIDGE-001 verified via curl GET/DELETE and dashboard

exit_criteria: View modal shows correct sprint details via GET and handles 404
Delete removes file and database records, survives Node restart, dashboard updated, and 404 on second delete
All 2 tickets pass with node --test relevant tests, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas, npm run build:web, git diff --check
